description.value: An Indian multinational technology company that builds cloud-based business software, including workplace productivity and collaboration tools, CRM software and business management tools.
An Indian, privately held technology company that makes cloud-based business software.
A cloud software company that sells a suite of business applications.
A privately held, bootstrapped software company that sells a broad cloud software suite, mainly on a subscription basis.

product_description.value: Business apps including CRM, Mail, Creator, Books, Desk and Bigin; Catalyst for building applications; Zia Agent Studio for AI agents; and Zoho One, an all-in-one suite of 50+ applications.
Zoho CRM, Zoho One, Zoho Workplace and Zoho Books; ManageEngine, its division, sells enterprise IT management and security software.

Zoho CRM, Zoho One (an integrated suite of more than 45 apps), Zoho Books, Zoho Workplace, Zoho Desk, Zoho People and the Arattai messaging app; ManageEngine sells enterprise IT management and security software.
CRM, Books (accounting), Projects, Desk (support) and Campaigns (email marketing), with about 55 products as of July 2024; Zoho One is an integrated suite that bundles them.

business_model_description.value: Zoho One, an all-in-one suite, has pricing that starts at a per-user rate (the amount is not shown on the page).

Sells its own software rather than services, mainly on a subscription basis. It has no advertising revenue model in any part of the business, including its free products. It runs a consulting partner program for outside firms that implement and support its products.

customer_description.value: More than one million paying organizations and 150 million users worldwide, as of February 2026.
More than one million paying organizations and 150 million users by February 2026, per the article.
Named brands include IIFL, SpiceJet, L'Oréal, Amazon, Tata Play, Zomato and Max Life Insurance, with testimonials from 5paisa.com and Mercedes-Benz India.
Targets small businesses, mid-sized companies, enterprises and home offices; a partner profile says it serves over 100 million users worldwide.
